name: poom
description: 품 Poom — 한부모 가족 쉐어하우스 웹앱

scripts.build:artifact: tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode artifact && node scripts/make-artifact.mjs
scripts.deploy:test: cross-env BUILD_CHANNEL=test npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name poom --branch dev
scripts.deploy:prod: node scripts/check-main.mjs && cross-env BUILD_CHANNEL=prod npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name poom --branch main
